title.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Tag：Slack 上的智能 AI 协作助手
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Tag, an agentic AI coworker for Slack that can learn context, give suggestions, and more, in beta for Claude Team and Enterprise tiers

summary.zh: 该助手可学习上下文、提供建议等，目前在 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 版本中测试。

title.zh: OpenAI 在戛纳国际创意节推出 ChatGPT 广告业务和 Codex
title.en: OpenAI debuts at Cannes Lions, pitching its new ChatGPT ad business and Codex to marketers, as it tries to build a multibillion-dollar business ahead of its IPO

summary.zh: OpenAI 向营销人员推介其广告业务和 Codex，旨在为其 IPO 前建立数十亿美元的业务。

title.zh: 消息称特朗普政府施压 Meta 提交 AI 模型进行自愿审查
title.en: Sources: the Trump administration is pressing Meta to submit its AI models for voluntary review; Meta is the only major US AI developer without an agreement

summary.zh: Meta 是唯一未签署相关协议的主要美国 AI 开发商。

title.zh: 字节跳动发布 Seedance 2.5，支持生成最长 30 秒视频
title.en: ByteDance unveils Seedance 2.5, saying the AI video model can generate up to 30-second clips from up to 50 reference materials, up from 12 for Seedance 2.0

summary.zh: 新版本支持从最多 50 个参考材料生成视频，相较 Seedance 2.0 的 12 个有显著提升。

title.zh: Mistral 推出 OCR 4 模型，支持 170 种语言的结构化文档提取
title.en: Mistral debuts OCR 4, a model featuring structured document extraction with bounding boxes, block classification, and inline confidence scores, in 170 languages

summary.zh: 该模型具备边界框、块分类和内联置信度评分功能。

title.zh: Google 推出 12 周孵化器计划，为 AI 初创公司提供支持
title.en: Google plans a 12-week incubator, picking 10 to 20 AI startups from its “Xoogler” alumni and providing up to $350K in cloud credits and $100K in direct funding

summary.zh: 计划从“Xoogler”校友中挑选 10 至 20 家 AI 初创公司，提供高达 35 万美元的云服务额度和 10 万美元直接资金。

title.zh: 荷兰加入美国主导的 Pax Silica 计划，协调 AI 供应链
title.en: The Netherlands joins the US-led Pax Silica initiative alongside South Korea and Japan to coordinate AI supply chains; Taiwan endorses it as a non-signatory

summary.zh: 韩国和日本也参与其中，台湾以非签署方身份表示支持。

title.zh: Menlo 筹集 30 亿美元支持 AI 初创公司
title.en: Menlo raised $3B for funds dedicated to backing AI startups, its largest fundraising to date; sources say Menlo's Anthropic stake is currently worth nearly $14B

summary.zh: 这是 Menlo 有史以来最大规模的募资，其在 Anthropic 的股份目前价值接近 140 亿美元。

title.zh: 阿布扎比 MGX 筹集近 500 亿美元加速 AI 投资
title.en: Sources: Abu Dhabi's MGX has raised close to $50B from regional sovereign wealth funds, global pension funds, and others to accelerate spending on AI deals

summary.zh: 资金来源包括地区主权财富基金、全球养老金基金等。

title.zh: Hadrian 正洽谈融资 10 亿美元，估值达 75 亿美元
title.en: Sources: Hadrian, which is building AI-powered factories to produce space and defense parts, is in talks to raise ~$1B at a ~$7.5B post-money valuation

summary.zh: 该公司正在建设用于生产航天和国防零部件的 AI 工厂。

title.zh: 中国基于Arm架构的LineShine超算超越美国El Capitan，成为全球最快超算
title.en: Top500: China's Arm-based LineShine passes the US' El Capitan by 20%+ as the world's fastest supercomputer, the first time China has taken the crown since 2017

summary.zh: 这是自2017年以来中国首次夺得全球最快超算的桂冠。

title.zh: SpaceX与开源AI初创公司Reflection签署高达63亿美元的计算力协议
title.en: SpaceX signs computing power deal with open-source AI startup Reflection worth up to $6.3 billion (4 minute read)

summary.zh: SpaceX通过提供其基础设施，进军AI和数据中心领域。
summary.en: SpaceX signed a deal worth up to $6.3 billion with Reflection AI for access to its supercomputer Project Colossus. This agreement allows Reflection to use Nvidia GB300s for training open-source AI models, reflecting a shift toward increased demand for compute power in AI development. SpaceX aims to capitalize on this by offering its infrastructure to outside AI companies, bolstering its position in the AI and data center space.

title.zh: OpenAI推出新安全工具并更新GPT-5.5-Cyber
title.en: OpenAI launches new security tools and updates GPT-5.5-Cyber (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 包括Codex安全插件更新、Daybreak网络安全合作伙伴计划和开源安全计划。
summary.en: OpenAI recently launched an updated Codex Security plugin, GPT-5.5-Cyber (in limited release), a Daybreak Cyber Partner Program, and an open source security initiative called Patch the Planet. Daybreak is a defensive cyber stack for the AI era. OpenAI is promoting Daybreak through a partner model rather than direct broad model access. It aims to embed GPT-5.5 with Trusted Access for Cyber into existing security products and services while keeping access governed through partner systems.

title.zh: 阿里巴巴AI视频模型全球排名升至第二
title.en: Alibaba's AI video model rises to No. 2 in global rankings, as OpenAI's Sora and ByteDance's Seedance fall away (14 minute read)

summary.zh: HappyHorse 1.1支持多种视频生成和编辑功能，现已上线阿里云。
summary.en: Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.1 AI video generation model delivers production-ready video through an API built for integration into enterprise software stacks. It is now live on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio with a 40% sitewide launch discount for the first two weeks. HappyHorse supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and subject-to-video generation, as well as video editing. Its abilities cover the full spectrum of commercial video needs, from ideation through production to post-production.

title.zh: 知识代理：通过更好的结构超越前沿模型
title.en: Knowledge Agents: Beat Frontier Models with Better Structure (18 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过嵌入、数据结构化和多次搜索增强LLM的专业查询能力。
summary.en: Anthropic pulled its Mythos model, while the article's author developed smaller agentic models called "knowledge agents" to match larger frontier models. These agents enhance AI by injecting specific, relevant knowledge, performing well even with smaller models like Qwen 3.6 27B. The methodology involves embedding, structuring data, and multiple search passes, successfully augmenting LLMs for specialized queries and proprietary data.

title.zh: GLM-5.2提升开源模型新标杆
title.en: GLM-5.2 Raises the Bar for Open Models (14 minute read)

summary.zh: GLM-5.2在能力和基准测试结果上显著优于之前的开源模型。
summary.en: TheZvi examined GLM-5.2's capabilities and benchmark results, arguing it represents a significant improvement over previous open models. The analysis positioned it as one of the strongest openly available models while still trailing the leading frontier systems.

title.zh: Moebius：高效轻量级图像修复框架
title.en: Moebius (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 0.22B模型在生成质量上超越11.9B工业级模型，推理速度提升15倍。
summary.en: Moebius is a highly efficient lightweight inpainting framework. The 0.22B model rivals and even surpasses the generation quality of the 11.9B industrial generalist FLUX.1-Fill-Dev. It does this with an under 15x acceleration in total inference time. Moebius liberates real-world image inpainting and AI object removal from parameter bloat.

title.zh: 循环工程详解
title.en: Loop Engineering Clearly Explained (7 minute read)

summary.zh: 从手动提示转向设计自主系统，解决停止条件、上下文腐化等问题。
summary.en: Loop engineering shifts AI development from manually prompting agents to designing autonomous systems that decide what to work on, execute tasks, verify outcomes, and improve over time. The core agent loop is simple, but the hard problems are defining reliable stopping conditions, preventing context rot, designing agent-friendly tools, and building verification mechanisms that can independently judge success.

title.zh: Anthropic计划为移动应用扩展Cowork支持
title.en: Anthropic prepares Cowork support for mobile apps (2 minute read)

summary.en: Anthropic plans to expand its Cowork system to mobile apps, enabling task scheduling and viewing across devices.

title.zh: 腾讯测试微信内AI助手以追赶竞争对手
title.en: Tencent tests AI assistant in China's most popular app as it looks to catch up with rivals (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 腾讯通过测试小微助手增强用户互动，挑战阿里巴巴等AI竞争者。
summary.en: Tencent is testing Xiaowei, an AI assistant, within WeChat to enhance user interaction and challenge AI competitors like Alibaba in China.
